comparison.objective: Lift a wine bottle bimanually and pour into a glass without spills or knockover; candidate commissions a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual vessel grasping and liquid pouring versus tool alignment, setscrew release, collar rotation, relocking, and dynamic-response observation.
comparison.success_condition: Pour succeeds with no spill or glass knockover; candidate succeeds only after two safe, repeatable, non-bottoming cycles with retained setting.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual coordination is generic; the mechanisms and outcomes differ.
